name: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun
unitComposition:
• 1 Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model
This model is equipped with: 1 Big Mek’s Toolz; 1 Shokk Attack Gun.

abilities.lore: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
abilities.name: Leader
abilities.rules: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: More Dakka
abilities.rules:
This unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Ignores Cover].
  • If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

abilities.name: Support Shokka
abilities.rules: While this model is within 3" of a friendly Orks Infantry unit (excluding BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN units), this model has Lone Operative.

rules.name: Leader

abilities.name: BLAST 1
abilities.rules: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], each time you gather attack dice for such a weapon, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. Example: If a [BLAST 2] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).

abilities.name: HEAVY
abilities.rules:
In your Shooting phase, each time an attack is made with a [HEAVY] weapon, add 1 to the hit roll if all of the following apply to the attacking unit:
  • That unit is unengaged.
  • That unit was not set up on the battlefield this turn.
  • No model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.
